* **Ipswich Borough Council**
* **Address:** Ipswich, Suffolk IP1 2DE
* **Salary:** £44,253 – £46,579 per annum
* **Hours:** 37 hours per week
* **Contract:** Permanent, required as soon as possible
* **Reference:** 0899

  

This is an exciting opportunity to join **Ipswich Borough Council** at the start of Local Plan making journey under the new plan\-making system and progress a programme of town centre regeneration. Following a re\-structure and considering these exciting workstreams, we are looking to expand our team with a motivated, ambitious **Senior Planning Officer**.

 **About Ipswich**


Ipswich is one of the fastest growing regional centres in England and is the largest centre in Suffolk for business, culture, entertainment and sports. A university town with a rich culture, heritage, elite sports teams and a thriving Waterfront. It is well connected to London and other parts of the country through strategic rail and road links.


The town is entering an important period, with the Council prioritising the delivery of key Town Centre regeneration and supporting the Ipswich City of Culture bid. Backed by successful Towns Fund investment and a strong regeneration pipeline, Ipswich offers a unique opportunity to help shape a vibrant, resilient and culturally rich town centre.

 **About the role**


The role primarily involves shaping the approach to Town Centre regeneration and the preparation of evidence base studies, monitoring and engagement to progress into the next Ipswich Local Plan, which commenced in June 2026\. By joining us now, you will play a key role from the earliest stages.


There is also significant opportunity to work collaboratively with neighbouring local authorities and Suffolk County Council on strategic planning matters. This role will allow the successful candidate the opportunity to further develop their skill set providing analysis and working to support other officers; report writing; project management; the opportunity to write guidance to expand on planning policy, and to get involved in helping to deliver allocations and regeneration by working with developers and site owners as well as input into master\-planning larger sites.


In addition, the role will also afford the opportunity to work closely with the Council’s busy Development Management team.

 **About you**


We’re looking for an enthusiastic and proactive Town Planner with a relevant degree or post graduate diploma or an NVQ Level 6 qualification in planning or a relevant field. Membership of the RTPI is required or actively being worked towards.


You will have previous Local Plan making experience.


In the context of a strong corporate emphasis on town centre regeneration and growth, we are keen to hear from candidates with experience of, or a strong interest in, town centre policy, regeneration and place\-based planning.


Effective project management and workload skills with a genuine passion for improving our built environment are a must. Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate with key stakeholders are essential.

 **Why work for us?**


Your hard work will be rewarded with a fantastic benefits package, including:

* a career average pension scheme
* generous holiday entitlement of 26 days (increasing to 32 days after five years of service)
* full payment of annual RTPI membership subscriptions
* free swimming and gym membership
* and flexibility to work from home and in the office.
* excellent travel benefits, including free travel on Ipswich Buses, discounts on Greater Anglia rail season and flexi\-season tickets, access to a cycle\-to\-work scheme
* subsidised parking in Ipswich Borough Council car parks for work and leisure.

  

We place a strong emphasis on personal and professional development and career progression. This is complemented by access to a supportive Employee Assistance Programme.


Join our vibrant team for hybrid working and seize the chance to shape Ipswich’s future. Don’t miss this opportunity to be part of a growing department that’s making Ipswich an even better place to live!

 **For more information**


Please read the **Job Description and Person Specification (pdf)**.


Please contact the Planning Policy Team Leaders, **Anna Roe** by calling **01473 432911** or email at **anna.roe@ipswich.gov.uk** or **Matt Deakin** on **01473 432490** or via email at **matt.deakin@ipswich.gov.uk**.

 **How to apply**


Please complete your application by visiting **our recruitment portal**.

 **Closing date:** 11\.55pm, 17 September 2026

**Interview date:** Week commencing 28 September or 5 October 2026

  

The selection process will involve an on\-site assessment test for candidates who are selected for interview.

However, if you are thinking of using this tool to submit your application, we ask you to think about what value it will add, with the exception of supporting accessibility or learning needs. The Planning Policy team is located within the Planning, Economy and Built Environment department, and is committed to planning positively to meet the growth needs of this special Borough. As one of the largest unitary authorities in the country, West Surrey will serve a diverse population across a region with a strong economy, vibrant communities, and significant opportunities for growth and innovation. * Hybrid working
* Flexible working and Flexi leave

The University of Westminster is seeking to appoint two Lecturers in Urban Planning to join the School of Architecture \+ Cities. These appointments will play a key role in the delivery and development of the MA Urban and Regional Planning and BA Urban Planning and Design, including course and module leadership, while strengthening the School's wider planning provision. The posts are available immediately, and the successful candidates will be expected to take up their appointment as soon as possible to contribute to the new academic year. The School of Architecture \+ Cities is one of the UK's leading built environment schools, bringing together architecture, interiors, planning and related disciplines in a vibrant, practice\-informed and research\-led environment. Based at the Marylebone Campus in central London, the School benefits from strong links to professional practice, a cross\-disciplinary culture and excellent studio and technical facilities. At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.


There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.


We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

 **Job Description** **Start here. Grow here.**


AECOM are looking for a Senior Consultant to join our Development Planning and Management Team in the South East, based in either our London, St Albans, Birmingham or Bristol office, to primarily to work on a Spatial Planning Contract for a key strategic client. The role would be providing development management advice to this client to assist them in protecting the operation, safety and future performance of the Strategic Road Network.


The candidate will act as a key team member reviewing relevant planning application documentation associated with development proposals affecting the Strategic Road Network (SRN). The role will include involvement in a range of planning consultations, undertaking high quality technical reviews of transport assessments and associated documents, mentoring junior staff and drawing on technical team’s expertise and building and maintaining client relationships.

*Here’s what you’ll bring:*

**Client and Stakeholder Engagement**: Build and maintain strong relationships with the client team through taking ownership of reviews and associated tasks, strong communication and organisational skills. There will be the opportunity to build experience of communication and liaison with public sector stakeholders, private developers and other third parties.

**Project Delivery:** Assisting the team in the overall delivery of individual tasks, meeting deadlines and managing one’s own workload and the workload of juniors, budget preparation and monitoring. You will undertake the review of transport planning documentation and ensuring the deliverables meet quality, budget, client and timeline requirements.

**Technical Skills:** A good understanding of Transport Assessments and the wider planning process with the ability to critically review third party documents, interrogate calculations, assumptions and associated information and successfully convey the outcomes competently in a Technical Note. It is expected that the candidate would have experience/ understanding of the following:

* Trip Generation
* Trip Distribution/ Assignment
* Junction Capacity Modelling (JUNCTIONS/ LINSIG and awareness of microsimulation/ strategic modelling ideally)
* Mitigation suitability


In addition, awareness of related transport documentation such as DMRB compliance reviews, GG104 Safety Risk Assessments, WCHARs, Road Safety Audits/ Documentation would be beneficial. Knowledge and/ or experience of working within the DCO process and Local Plan Examination process would also be advantageous.

**Come grow with us.**


We develop projects from concept through to operation providing engineering and construction services for multiyear, multimillion\-dollar projects for major rail and transit agencies. Our specialists provide analytical and strategic expertise for every stage of a project


And let's not forget about the perks at AECOM. You'll enjoy a range of core and personalised benefits designed to support your future and well\-being, customized to fit your lifestyle. Take advantage of career development opportunities, our flexible hybrid working model to ensure a work\-life balance that suits your lifestyle, technical practice networks, AECOM University, and volunteering days.

 **Qualifications** **Ready to push the limits of what’s possible?**

*Here’s what we’re looking for:*

  

* Degree in Transport Planning, Civil Engineering, Spatial/ Urban Planning, or a related field
* Membership of a professional body such as the Chartered Institution of Highways and Transportation (CIHT), Transport Planning Society (TPS) or Chartered Institute of Logistics and Transport (CILT)
* Excellent team working, written, communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills
* Awareness/ knowledge of transport planning principles, policies, and regulations in the UK
* Experience and enthusiasm in helping mentor and develop junior staff
* Experience in transport modelling (local, and ideally strategic)
* Proficiency in commonly used transport planning tools and software and excellent knowledge of Microsoft Word and Excel


At AECOM, we value everyone's unique contributions and perspectives.


If you meet some of the requirements above or have transferable skills you believe would benefit us, we would be delighted to hear from you!

The University of Westminster is seeking to appoint two Lecturers in Urban Planning to join the School of Architecture \+ Cities. These appointments will play a key role in the delivery and development of the MA Urban and Regional Planning and BA Urban Planning and Design, including course and module leadership, while strengthening the School's wider planning provision. The posts are available immediately, and the successful candidates will be expected to take up their appointment as soon as possible to contribute to the new academic year. The number of postholders and their individual FTE will be confirmed during the appointment process, taking into account candidate availability and preferred working patterns.


The School of Architecture \+ Cities is one of the UK's leading built environment schools, bringing together architecture, interiors, planning and related disciplines in a vibrant, practice\-informed and research\-led environment. Based at the Marylebone Campus in central London, the School benefits from strong links to professional practice, a cross\-disciplinary culture and excellent studio and technical facilities. The successful candidates will teach across undergraduate and postgraduate planning courses, supervise dissertation and/or final projects, and contribute to curriculum enhancement and student support, including course and module leadership where required, as well as to the broader scholarly and professional life of the School.



Applicants should have a PhD or equivalent professional or practice\-based experience in planning or a closely related field, together with teaching experience in higher education or equivalent relevant professional experience, and a research, knowledge exchange or professional practice profile appropriate to the post. 	+ UK planning law, planning policy, development management, plan\-making and planning implementation.
	+ Urban design, site appraisal, delivery, viability or negotiation.
	+ Housing, regeneration and urban change.
	+ Economic development, land and property markets, and local economies.

At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.


There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.


We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

 **Job Description** **Start here. Grow here.**


AECOM are looking for a Senior Consultant to join our Development Planning and Management Team in the South East, based in either our London, St Albans, Birmingham or Bristol office, to primarily to work on a Spatial Planning Contract for a key strategic client. The role would be providing development management advice to this client to assist them in protecting the operation, safety and future performance of the Strategic Road Network.


The candidate will act as a key team member reviewing relevant planning application documentation associated with development proposals affecting the Strategic Road Network (SRN). The role will include involvement in a range of planning consultations, undertaking high quality technical reviews of transport assessments and associated documents, mentoring junior staff and drawing on technical team’s expertise and building and maintaining client relationships.

*Here’s what you’ll bring:*

**Client and Stakeholder Engagement**: Build and maintain strong relationships with the client team through taking ownership of reviews and associated tasks, strong communication and organisational skills. There will be the opportunity to build experience of communication and liaison with public sector stakeholders, private developers and other third parties.

**Project Delivery:** Assisting the team in the overall delivery of individual tasks, meeting deadlines and managing one’s own workload and the workload of juniors, budget preparation and monitoring. You will undertake the review of transport planning documentation and ensuring the deliverables meet quality, budget, client and timeline requirements.

**Technical Skills:** A good understanding of Transport Assessments and the wider planning process with the ability to critically review third party documents, interrogate calculations, assumptions and associated information and successfully convey the outcomes competently in a Technical Note. It is expected that the candidate would have experience/ understanding of the following:

* Trip Generation
* Trip Distribution/ Assignment
* Junction Capacity Modelling (JUNCTIONS/ LINSIG and awareness of microsimulation/ strategic modelling ideally)
* Mitigation suitability


In addition, awareness of related transport documentation such as DMRB compliance reviews, GG104 Safety Risk Assessments, WCHARs, Road Safety Audits/ Documentation would be beneficial. Knowledge and/ or experience of working within the DCO process and Local Plan Examination process would also be advantageous.

**Come grow with us.**


We develop projects from concept through to operation providing engineering and construction services for multiyear, multimillion\-dollar projects for major rail and transit agencies. Our specialists provide analytical and strategic expertise for every stage of a project


And let's not forget about the perks at AECOM. You'll enjoy a range of core and personalised benefits designed to support your future and well\-being, customized to fit your lifestyle. Take advantage of career development opportunities, our flexible hybrid working model to ensure a work\-life balance that suits your lifestyle, technical practice networks, AECOM University, and volunteering days.

 **Qualifications** **Ready to push the limits of what’s possible?**

*Here’s what we’re looking for:*

  

* Degree in Transport Planning, Civil Engineering, Spatial/ Urban Planning, or a related field
* Membership of a professional body such as the Chartered Institution of Highways and Transportation (CIHT), Transport Planning Society (TPS) or Chartered Institute of Logistics and Transport (CILT)
* Excellent team working, written, communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills
* Awareness/ knowledge of transport planning principles, policies, and regulations in the UK
* Experience and enthusiasm in helping mentor and develop junior staff
* Experience in transport modelling (local, and ideally strategic)
* Proficiency in commonly used transport planning tools and software and excellent knowledge of Microsoft Word and Excel


At AECOM, we value everyone's unique contributions and perspectives.


If you meet some of the requirements above or have transferable skills you believe would benefit us, we would be delighted to hear from you!
